You name the flaw in the guard, then strike through it before the target can close the gap.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Knowledge
Target / range / shape
One visible creature or active device within 5 squares; one ally within 5 squares who can hear and understand you.
Duration
The attack resolves immediately. The resistance loss lasts until the end of the scene; the Boon expires when used or the start of your next turn.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Once on your turn; one resistance reduction per target per scene.
Type
Signature
Weak
deal 5 physical damage.
Standard
deal 7 physical damage.
Strong
deal 9 physical damage. The target loses 1 resistance of your choice until the end of the scene, and the chosen ally gains 1 Boon to their next attack against it before the start of your next turn.
